subject: MTA Contract Ratification
overview: The Medford School Committee ratified a new three-year contract with the Medford Teachers Association and approved the 2025-2026 school calendar. The committee also adjusted tuition rates for school-run childcare and preschool programs.

items.title: Security Project Vote
items.summary: Approved the security project and referred it to the mayor and council with a recommendation to maximize the use of free cash to reduce annual payments.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, which included minutes from the April 7th regular meeting.

items.title: Medford Teachers Association Contract Ratification
items.summary: Approved the ratification of a new three-year contract with the Medford Teachers Association, which adds 15 minutes to the school day and reduces half days.

items.title: 2025-2026 School Year Calendar
items.summary: Approved 'Option Triangle' for the 2025-2026 school calendar and referred recommended calendar policy revisions to the Policy Subcommittee.

items.title: Tuition and Program Rate Adjustments
items.summary: Approved tuition rate adjustments for Kids' Corner and a three percent increase for the MEEP program, before recessing to address technical difficulties with Zoom.
